title: Vertex volumes, lattice-minima tails, and height zeta functions for the standard arithmetic quotient of $\operatorname{PGL}_d$
summary: We study the standard nonuniform arithmetic quotient of the affine Bruhat--Tits building attached to $\operatorname{PGL}_d(\mathbb F_q(\!(t^{-1})\!))$, with Haar measure normalized so that a maximal compact subgroup has volume one. We first compute its vertex volume in closed product form. The proof is entirely building-theoretic: vertices are parametrized by a dominant sector, their stabilizers are counted exactly, and the resulting sum over block compositions is evaluated by a cut-set recursion. On the same quotient, we introduce a homothety-invariant normalized lattice-minima height $α$.…
